name: paper_pseudo_ocv_discharge
description: Stage 0: pseudo-OCV C/20 discharge for electrode balancing / OCP check
comment: C/20 discharge, full cell to min_v, ~20h expected duration (25h safety ceiling). Precondition: fully charge the cell and rest >=1h before starting this file. Sampling every 30s -- well above the EBC's hardware-fixed ~1Hz floor, plenty for a slow OCV sweep. This data is for OCV-SOC balancing only, deliberately down-weighted in the dynamic fit -- not used for kinetic parameters. NMC/NCA cells (cellAlex as configured): this discharge-only pass is normally sufficient. LFP cells: also run 01b_pseudo_ocv_charge.json in the opposite direction and average the two OCV curves to cancel hysteresis (Kang et al.).
